name: Spicy Chili Powder Jar
skillFull: A jar of red chili powder flutters forward at certain intervals, sprinkling spicy Chili Powder Jellies in its wake. Obstacles in its path turn bright red as they struggle to handle the spice. Destroy them for extra destruction points. Level Up for more points for Chili Powder Jellies and more destruction points for red obstacles.
